cases.text: A battery powers a motor that spins a fan.
A librarian places a book on a shelf while a student watches.
A solar panel converts sunlight into electricity for a lamp.
Rain flows from a roof into a barrel through a gutter.
A robot carries a box across a bridge to a workshop.
A caterpillar eats a leaf before becoming a butterfly.
A syringe pushes medicine through a tube into a patient.
A clock hand moves clockwise around a dial.
A magnet pulls an iron nail toward it.
A bee carries pollen from a flower to its hive.
A kite floats above a tree while its string stays attached to a child.
Steam rises from a cup and condenses on a cool lid.
